name: 创新自适应卡尔曼趋势估计
summary: 依据前一根估计和协方差预测当前价格；异常创新会提高测量噪声，降低当前价格的校正权重。
formula:
```python
sourcePrice = close
NOISE_DECAY = 0.9
anomalyThreshold = pow(anomalyMultiple, 2)
# 仅在首根初始化，随后跨 K 线保留
estimate = na
# 仅在首根初始化，随后跨 K 线保留
estimateVariance = 1.0
# 仅在首根初始化，随后跨 K 线保留
measurementNoise = 0.0
# 仅在首根初始化，随后跨 K 线保留
meanSurprise = 0.0
# 仅在首根初始化，随后跨 K 线保留
surpriseVariance = 0.0
# 仅在首根初始化，随后跨 K 线保留
processNoise = 0.0
processNoiseRatio = pow(2.0 / (smoothingPeriod + 1), 2)
if is_na(estimate):
    estimate = sourcePrice
    firstMove = pow(sourcePrice - history('sourcePrice', 1), 2)
    surpriseVariance = firstMove if firstMove > 0 else 0.0001
    meanSurprise = 0.0
    measurementNoise = surpriseVariance
    estimateVariance = surpriseVariance
    processNoise = surpriseVariance * processNoiseRatio
predictedEstimate = estimate
predictedVariance = estimateVariance + processNoise
surprise = sourcePrice - predictedEstimate
centeredSurprise = surprise - meanSurprise if useTrendCentering else surprise
testStatistic = pow(centeredSurprise, 2) / surpriseVariance
isAnomaly = testStatistic > anomalyThreshold
statAlpha = 2.0 / (noiseLookback + 1)
meanSurprise = (1.0 - statAlpha) * meanSurprise + statAlpha * surprise
surpriseVariance = (1.0 - statAlpha) * surpriseVariance + statAlpha * pow(centeredSurprise, 2)
updatedNoise = measurementNoise
if isAnomaly:
    updatedNoise = outlierRejection * pow(centeredSurprise, 2) + measurementNoise
else:
    updatedNoise = (1.0 - NOISE_DECAY) * surpriseVariance + NOISE_DECAY * measurementNoise
measurementNoise = updatedNoise
kalmanGain = predictedVariance / (predictedVariance + updatedNoise)
estimate = predictedEstimate + kalmanGain * surprise
estimateVariance = (1.0 - kalmanGain) * predictedVariance
processNoise = surpriseVariance * processNoiseRatio
return estimate
```

Higher holds the filter line back harder when a shock hits, so the line ignores more of it. The trade-off is that when the move turns out to be real, the line takes longer to catch up.

0.1: 25 to 40, fading in about 20 bars
0.3: 50 to 70, fading in about 40 bars

At 0 nothing is damped. The dots still show, but the meter stays near zero and no volatility shifts are marked.

Which bars get dots is set by the Unusual-Move Threshold.")
